code_path: fixed repository root only; publication uses a disposable GIT_INDEX_FILE and commit-tree; no git worktree add/checkout
normal_report_path: reporter -> validate/render -> same attempt report-input.json/report.html/review-input.json/review.json/result.json -> independent reviewer -> reporter revision loop -> publication
fallback_path: normal report outcome/exception -> failure journal -> build_fallback_report -> same formal report attempt -> independent reviewer real invocation -> findings incorporated and re-reviewed -> review unavailable recorded truthfully if invocation fails -> publication attempted
publication_recovery: remote report commit is searched by unique commit message and exact path/hash; after push-before-sidecar interruption, same job reuses remote commit and saves publication sidecar/readback
completion_semantics: A published report with unavailable review can complete the workflow operation while incident_resolution remains unknown/in_progress; report approval and incident resolution are not inferred.
not_performed: actual role session invocation and production report (FC10)
DB apply or production database operation
next_actions: FC07 run focused reporter/reviewer/fallback/publication interruption cases
FC08 independent product code review and return findings
FC10 launch the report roles and publish real HTML for the same immutable job identity
review_unavailable_contract: result.stage_status=review_unavailable, report_status=pending, review.status=unavailable; this is not an approval. Terminal readback accepts it only with a matching published report artifact and remote hash.
actual_role_invocation: NOT_PERFORMED in FC06 by stage assignment; FC10 must invoke the actual reporter and independent reviewer for the same immutable job.
